latest.title: The truncated octahedron minimizes surface area among parallelohedra of equal volume
latest.abstract: We prove that the regular truncated octahedron uniquely minimizes surface area among all parallelohedra of fixed volume. Equivalently, every three-dimensional parallelohedron $P$ satisfies \[ \frac{\mathcal H^2(\partial P)}{|P|^{2/3}} \ge \frac{3(1+2\sqrt3)}{4^{2/3}}, \] with equality if and only if $P$ is similar to the regular truncated octahedron. Among the non-truncated Fedorov types we prove a stronger sharp bound, attained uniquely by the regular rhombic dodecahedron.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 证明固定体积的所有三维 parallelohedra 中，正截角八面体唯一最小化表面积；其余 Fedorov 类型中正菱形十二面体给出更强尖锐界。
techniques: 行列式概率与杠杆分数
latest.breakthrough: 将 BCC 局部极小推进为全局结论，并通过仿射度量自由度的行列式控制覆盖非 Voronoi 的一般 parallelohedra。
latest.limitations: 不覆盖任意周期等体积分割，因而不是 Kelvin 问题的解；需独立核查尖锐代数不等式及等号链。
latest.aiEvidence: 作者明确说明使用 ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Sol) 检查代数恒等式，并协助探索和验证证明论证。
latest.priorityReason: 解决清楚的经典几何优化问题，技术衔接凸几何、图行列式与熵，且已核对定理与证明架构。
